Verified further via the venue's own Instagram (@attilio_bar, 4,522 followers, bio 'Qui si riparano ricordi' — matches the found-portrait origin story) and official site (attiliobar.it, one-page site, logo only, no gallery). Address and coordinates confirmed via Google Maps listing (Attilio Bar, Via di Villa Chigi 68, 00199 Roma; 41.935142, 12.5143848; geocode confidence 1.0) — also surfaced current rating (4.6/31 reviews), hours (nightly 18:00–00:00, no closing day), phone, and specific reviewer testimony (parmigiana called out by name, pricing called fair, wine/sparkling/beer selection praised specifically).
